what: the same coil trimmed flat by cutting away everything above z = 12.5 with a box (trimming a coil to length)
method: a disc of radius 1 whose centre rises with the screw (z0 = 4 theta / 2 pi) keeps the part below z = 12.5, symmetric about its vertical diameter, so its centroid stays at radius R = 20: V = R (2 pi / p) integral over z0 in [0,24] of Ak(12.5 - z0) dz0 with Ak(h) = rs^2 (t sqrt(1-t^2) + asin t + pi/2), t = h/rs, clamped to 0 below -rs and pi rs^2 above rs: V = 1234.893 (Gauss-Legendre).
